summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.49/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.49 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 17, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since July 8. AAA figures put the statewide average 29¢ lower than a week ago, 65¢ lower than a month ago, and 80¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.14) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.01).
